contents.cn: 每周五总结这一周发生的事情。
contents.en: Summarize the events of the week every Friday.

contents.cn: 请分析以下终端报错日志，找出导致该错误的根本原因，并提供可以直接运行的修复代码示例。
contents.en: Please analyze the following terminal error log, find the root cause of the error, and provide a sample of fix code that can be run directly.

contents.cn: 帮我创建一份PPT，主题是「AI Agent 进化之路」，内容涵盖三个阶段：Prompt Engineering（起源、核心技巧、局限性）→ Context Engineering（为什么context更重要、RAG/Memory/Tool Use等关键技术）→ Harness Engineering（Agent框架演进、代表产品如AutoGPT/ACPAgent/OpenClaw）。风格科技感，深色背景，要有时间线贯穿
contents.en: Please create a PowerPoint presentation for me on the topic "The Evolution of AI Agents," covering three stages: Prompt Engineering (origins, core techniques, limitations) → Context Engineering (why context is important, key technologies such as RAG/Memory/Tool Use) → Harness Engineering (agent framework evolution, representative products such as AutoGPT/ACPAgent/OpenClaw). The style should be tech-oriented, with a dark background, and a timeline should be clearly presented.

contents.cn: 汇总上一个工作日以来的提交、模块变化、CI 状态和待跟进事项，最终生成不超过 6 条的晨会口述摘要。只读分析，只使用可验证的仓库事实；证据不足时明确说明，不推测，也不修改代码或外部状态。
contents.en: Summarize commits, module changes, CI status, and follow-ups since the previous workday, then produce no more than five stand-up-ready bullets. Perform read-only analysis using only verifiable repository facts; state when evidence is insufficient, do not speculate, and do not modify code or external state.

contents.cn: 检查最近 24 小时的代码变更，识别运行错误、数据丢失、权限绕过、资源泄漏及跨端兼容等高置信风险，并附代码和 commit/diff 证据。只读分析，只使用可验证的仓库事实；证据不足时明确说明，不推测，也不修改代码或外部状态。
contents.en: Inspect code changes from the last 24 hours for high-confidence risks involving runtime failures, data loss, authorization bypasses, resource leaks, or cross-platform compatibility, and attach code and commit/diff evidence. Perform read-only analysis using only verifiable repository facts; state when evidence is insufficient, do not speculate, and do not modify code or external state.

contents.cn: 整理本周合并的 PR 和 commit，按功能、修复、体验及工程改进分类，同时生成团队版和面向用户的精简发布说明。只读分析，只使用可验证的仓库事实；证据不足时明确说明，不推测，也不修改代码或外部状态。
contents.en: Organize PRs and commits merged this week into Features, Fixes, Experience improvements, and Engineering improvements, then produce both a team brief and concise user-facing release notes. Perform read-only analysis using only verifiable repository facts; state when evidence is insufficient, do not speculate, and do not modify code or external state.

contents.cn: 对照最近 7 天的代码、配置、接口与文档变更，识别已改变公开行为但文档尚未同步的高置信差异，并附文件路径和 commit/diff 证据，给出应更新的文档位置与要点。只读分析，只使用可验证的仓库事实；证据不足时明确说明，不推测，也不修改代码或外部状态。
contents.en: Compare code, configuration, API, and documentation changes from the last seven days. Identify high-confidence cases where public behavior changed without matching documentation, attach file paths and commit/diff evidence, and name the documentation locations and key points that should be updated. Perform read-only analysis using only verifiable repository facts; state when evidence is insufficient, do not speculate, and do not modify code or external state.
